children: Richtech Robotics received a statement of work for the sale and five-year deployment of 200 DUST-E autonomous cleaning robots.
Client under existing Master Services Agreement agreed to purchase and deploy 200 DUST-E robots over five years.
SOW includes ongoing ancillary services such as automated reporting and remote support, enhancing recurring service revenue.
Transaction executed under previously disclosed MSA with a national retailer, expanding commercial deployment.
